summary: Odysight.ai Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $20 million of common stock through Roth Capital Partners as agent. Shares trade on Nasdaq and TASE under ODYS; last reported Nasdaq price $4.33 on June 4, 2026. Agent receives up to 3.0% commission. The filing is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5) and does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, or any special-situation event. There are no deal terms or structural changes beyond providing ongoing liquidity. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is present. Watch for gradual market absorption; no risk-arb angle.
